phases.name: Logging, routines, settings, and rest sounds
requirements: Remove use-last-values control; emphasize icon-only logging action
Compact routine overview, grouped preset rows, consistent drag preview and edit dialogs
Consistent settings groups and clear explanation of max-weight estimation
Choose and preview device sounds; persist selection and preserve old backups
Emulator testing, split ABI build, and commit before Analysis follow-up
Verify chosen sound and completion notification fire with screen locked, before unlocking
Confirmation before workout/set/routine deletion; successful workout deletion exits selection mode; no Undo snackbars

emulator: Routine overview and grouped preset cards
Preset dialog at emulator width; fixed intrinsic layout failure
Delete cancellation keeps selection; confirming exits edit mode without snackbar
Device ringtone selected and retained across APK update
Selected ringtone playing with power Asleep and keyguard showing=true
One Rest complete notification posted before unlock; notification and service cleared automatically

phases.name: Analysis follow-up
requirements: Test original FitNotes Analysis with dummy workout data
Filters: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, All time, custom range
Emulator testing, split ABI build, and commit

observations: Workout graph points use actual calendar-date spacing
Trend Line toggle adds a straight date-based fit
Custom Date asks for start and end dates and includes both endpoints
Missing workout times show no records, rather than zero-duration workouts
Breakdown defaults to set counts by category; dummy data was Chest 80%, Back 20%
reference.restore_status: Restored through native Restore. All 24 database tables matched the pre-test backup, including settings and both original training_log rows.

findings_fixed: Routine hints now use the same lastSet query as routine application, including latest-created/id ordering.
Compact Custom range button has an accessibility label.

emulator: Normal text: graph, filters and training balance fit one screen.
One month: 3 completed workouts; volumes 200, 960, 730 kg; sets 1, 2, 2; reps 10, 16, 14; durations 30, 45, 40 minutes.
Training balance: Chest 4 sets (80%), Back 1 set (20%); uncompleted planned Row excluded.
Three months: Chest 4 / Back 2. Six months: Chest 5 / Back 2. All time: Chest 6 / Back 2.
Held October 8 duration bar shows October 8, 2026 and 45:00; date-spaced trend renders across actual workout dates.
Custom range cancellation retains 1 month. October 8–10 includes both endpoint workouts and updates the pie to Chest 4 sets, 100%.
Dark mode and Android text scale 1.6: filters remain one row; graph, category labels and both pie sections remain visible without overflow.
Final ARM64 release installed and launched. Compact Custom range accessibility label verified in the release APK. Restored Home contains no fixture workouts.

restore.status: Original database and preferences restored byte-for-byte. After schema 4 to 5 migration, every original column and row matched. Rest sound URI defaults to null.
